name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Two buffer modes. Predictive: if clicking now would kill you, your click is held back and the mod fires its own click at the first moment that survives. Classic: a click made in the air is remembered and fired when you land.

enabled.name: Enable Buffer
enabled.description: Turn the buffer on or off without restarting.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: You can't die to spikes, blocks or saws. For practice only.

mode.name: Buffer mode
mode.description: Predictive: holds back a click that would kill you and fires its own at a moment that survives. Classic: remembers a click made in the air and fires it when you land.

classic-ticks.name: Classic: buffer window (ticks)
classic-ticks.description: Classic mode only. How long before landing a click is remembered. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS, 240 ticks = 1 second. High values feel like the mod is clicking for you.

wave-release.name: Predictive: predict wave releases
wave-release.description: Predictive mode only. Also hold back wave releases that would crash.

wave-enabled.name: Predictive: use in wave
wave-enabled.description: Predictive mode only. Off by default: the simulation does not model the wave well, so with this on it may hold clicks back for no reason. When off, all wave inputs pass through untouched.

max-delay-frames.name: Predictive: maximum wait (frames)
max-delay-frames.description: Predictive mode only. The longest a click may be held back while waiting for a safe moment. Raise this to be able to click very early. 1 frame = 4 physics ticks at 60 FPS.

lookahead-ticks.name: Predictive: look-ahead (ticks)
lookahead-ticks.description: Predictive mode only. How far ahead each prediction runs. 240 ticks = 1 second.

hold-ticks.name: Predictive: assumed hold length (ticks)
hold-ticks.description: Predictive mode only. How long the prediction assumes you hold each click before releasing.

time-budget-ms.name: Predictive: time budget per check (ms)
time-budget-ms.description: Predictive mode only. Each safety check (one per tick while a click is held back) is cut off after this long. Too low and the mod can't decide in time.

debug.name: Debug messages
debug.description: Show a short on-screen message for every click explaining what the buffer decided.
